notes.title: Synthetic phantom protocol
notes.text: The synthetic study uses a geometric sphere phantom. It is not a patient study. Inference returns phantom-present when the bright fraction crosses the fixture threshold.

notes.title: Export rule
notes.text: Export to an external record system is a high-risk action. A named approver must record an approval id before the API accepts the export. The reader role cannot approve.

notes.title: De-identification rule
notes.text: The de-identification rule accepts the name SYNTHETIC. A study identifier must start with SYN-. An accession number, a birth date, or any other identifier fails the gate.
